body: On 2026-11-07 I told Sol-a7bb that w-f5b824b8e5d6 was "landed and closed". It had landed in fdbb53c8 but was still open, and Sol-a7bb caught this before cleaning up. Before telling anyone an item is closed, read its state with show; "landed" and "closed" are different states. Also: an item whose only bound test is #[cfg(target_os = "linux")] cannot get credit from a registered run on Central (Windows). Closing it needs a registered Linux route on the store that holds the claim. I asked Opus2 on 2026-11-07 whether such a route exists.
